expr: (() => { const S=window.simState; return S.m===1 && S.v1===2 && S.puskuri==='kova' && S.tormays==='pysahtyy' && S.running===false && S.t===0 && S.dt===null && S.I===null && S.dp===null ? 1 : 0 })()
note: on load: 1,0 kg cart at 2,0 m/s, hard bumper, the cart stops; not running, nothing measured yet

expr: (() => { const R=document.querySelectorAll('#sim-root input[type=range]'); return R.length===1 && R[0].min==='0.5' && R[0].max==='2' && R[0].step==='0.5' ? 1 : 0 })()
note: one slider: initial speed 0,5-2,0 m/s in steps of 0,5 m/s

expr: (() => { const L=[...document.querySelectorAll('#sim-root select')].map(s=>[...s.options].map(o=>o.value).join(',')); return L.length===4 && L[0]==='0.5,1,2' && L[1]==='kova,keski,pehmea' && L[2]==='pysahtyy,kimpoaa' && L[3]==='0.1,0.25,1' ? 1 : 0 })()
note: selects: mass, bumper, collision type, speed (hidas, normaali, nopea)

expr: (() => { const b=[...document.querySelectorAll('#sim-root button')].map(x=>x.textContent); const k=[...document.getElementById('sim-root').children].map(e=>e.tagName==='CANVAS'?'canvas':e.className); return b[0]==='Käynnistä' && b[1]==='Alusta' && k.indexOf('canvas')<k.indexOf('controls') && k.indexOf('controls')<k.indexOf('readout') ? 1 : 0 })()
note: main button first; DOM order canvas, controls, readout

expr: (() => { const n=document.querySelectorAll('#sim-root p.note'); return !document.querySelector('#sim-root details') && n.length===1 && n[0].textContent.trim().split(/\s+/).length<=15 ? 1 : 0 })()
note: no Lisätietoja box; one legend line of at most 15 words

expr: (() => { const P=window.simAdapter && window.simAdapter.params; return P && Object.keys(P).sort().join(',')==='m,puskuri,tormays,v1' && P.m.unit==='kg' && P.v1.unit==='m/s' ? 1 : 0 })()
note: adapter declares m (kg), v1 (m/s), puskuri and tormays

expr: (() => { const c=document.querySelector('#sim-root canvas'); const n=document.getElementById('sim-root').clientWidth<500; return c.width===600 && (n ? c.height>400 : c.height===400) ? 1 : 0; })()
note: canvas is 600 wide: 400 tall on a wide screen, taller (panels stacked) when the sim box is under 500 px
